Phase 4 (round 4) calibrates on text-nav-cut (gesture navigation): T, a 74-px string box drawn across the band's top (2105–2179, the band from 2154), its own 49-px node ending flush at the band. This red is a CONTRACT, not a device-measured misread: the band under gesture navigation is transparent, and what the 94bae14 assert sampled is T's own colour (66 % of the region) — ADR 0009 N-b (a pixel assert whose sampled region a band overlaps past the slack fails closed: rows.ts#overlapColour) makes that PASS the mismatch. It is the note's fix (e85bcdf: the navigation band read, a pixel assert past the slack fails closed) that the row calibrates, not the note's misreading. T's `ocr` row on the same geometry takes the other rule on purpose (golden-spec/text.ts, as rows.ts#bandColour for the app's band): the string is drawn whole beneath the handle, so a PASS reading it right is true of the screen, and only a FAIL on a reading — the note's symptom — is red.
